completion_rule: An operation becomes COMPLETE only after its CoreSpec law, bounded Program admission, independent expected observations, source producer, VM and real native AOT behavior, and removal of replaced canonical dependencies are verified. Reference models are optional; existing useful model tests remain until equivalent observation checks take over.

precut_route_policy.state_during_w7: each migrated product route is canonical-only and fail-closed; uncovered capabilities remain explicitly incomplete
precut_route_policy.cutover: each development route removes its legacy reachability atomically; terminal closure removes every remaining old product node together

core_spec_stage.note: The CoreSpec registry and normative KATs own operation laws. Generated per-consumer coverage records implementation; source and product qualification are separate.

program_format_stage.note: W2 owns canonical bytes and bounded structural decode. W3 owns typed admission, and both product executors consume the same validated program without reconstructing source semantics.

semantic_admission_stage.note: Active operations have bounded semantic verification. Independent KAT expectations and hostile Program mutations determine correctness; Reference coverage is not a language admission requirement.

vm_stage.note: The current VM still executes both private views. Their retirement requires shared execution and lifecycle checks, including text ownership; source product qualification remains separate.

aot_stage.native_identity: ExecutionId + BackendId + ToolchainId + OptimizationPolicyId + native bytes
aot_stage.note: Active operations have BackendIR and portable C11 lowering. Real source native tests check behavior; complete product-entry qualification remains separate.
